title: Capacity and Connectivity Bounds for European Hydrogen Import Corridors: Reproducibility Code and Derived Data
description: Major revision of the public hydrogen corridor screen. The active, portable workflow is revisions/v2.0.0. It includes derived public planning data, explicit directed capacity graphs, all 511 terminal subsets, 259200 joint endpoint assignments, full optimal tie sets, matched-vintage stress tests and nine vector/900 dpi figures. Values are conditional annual planning bounds, not actual operating throughput or investment recommendations. Root-level v1 files are historical and superseded. Manuscript authorship is separate from archive creator metadata. Original third-party workbooks are not redistributed; their terms remain applicable.
